declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_congr
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v w : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_singleton
declarations.signature:

    (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (v (Singleton.singleton.{u_1, u_1} i)) (v EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u_1}))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_insert
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),

    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i S))
      (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.marginal.{u_1} v i) S)

declarations.signature:

declarations.signature:

declarations.signature:

declarations.signature:

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_const
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (c : Real) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (fun (x : Finset.{u_1} α) => c) S)
    (ite.{1} (Eq.{u_1 + 1} S EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u_1}) c 0)

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_centered
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} v) S)
    (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v S)

declarations.signature:

    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} v) S) (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v S)

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_recursive
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v S)
    (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (v S) (∑ T ∈ Finset.erase.{u_1} (Finset.powerset.{u_1} S) S, Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v T))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.unanimity

declarations.name: Harsanyi.reconstruct_single
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (A : Finset.{u_1} α) (c : Real) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.reconstruct.{u_1} (fun (T : Finset.{u_1} α) => ite.{1} (Eq.{u_1 + 1} T A) c 0) S)
    (Harsanyi.unanimity.{u_1} A c S)

declarations.signature:

  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.unanimity.{u_1} A c) S) (ite.{1} (Eq.{u_1 + 1} S A) c 0)

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_dummy
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  ∀ i ∉ S,
    (∀ (T : Finset.{u_1} α), HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} T S → Eq.{1} (v (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i T)) (v T)) →
      Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i S)) 0

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_relabel
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] {β : Type u_2} [DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} β] (e : Equiv.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} α β)
  (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Eq.{1}
    (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_2}
      (fun (U : Finset.{u_2} β) =>
        v (Finset.map.{u_2, u_1} (Equiv.toEmbedding.{u_2 + 1, u_1 + 1} (Equiv.symm.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} e)) U))
      (Finset.map.{u_1, u_2} (Equiv.toEmbedding.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} e) S))
    (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v S)

declarations.name: Harsanyi.dividendAllocation
declarations.signature: {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] → Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α → Finset.{u_1} α → α → Real

declarations.name: Harsanyi.dividendAllocation_add
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v w : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (N : Finset.{u_1} α) (i : α),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.dividendAllocation.{u_1} (fun (S : Finset.{u_1} α) => HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (v S) (w S)) N i)
    (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Harsanyi.dividendAllocation.{u_1} v N i) (Harsanyi.dividendAllocation.{u_1} w N i))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.sum_dividend_shares
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (x : Real) (N S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} S N →
    Eq.{1} (∑ i ∈ N, ite.{1} (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} S i) (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} x ↑(Finset.card.{u_1} S)) 0)
      (ite.{1} (Eq.{u_1 + 1} S EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u_1}) 0 x)

declarations.name: Harsanyi.dividendAllocation_efficiency
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (N : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Eq.{1} (∑ i ∈ N, Harsanyi.dividendAllocation.{u_1} v N i)
    (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (v N) (v EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u_1}))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.dividendAllocation_centered
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (N : Finset.{u_1} α) (i : α),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.dividendAllocation.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} v) N i) (Harsanyi.dividendAllocation.{u_1} v N i)

declarations.name: Harsanyi.dividendAllocation_unanimity
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (A N : Finset.{u_1} α) (c : Real) (i : α),
  HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} A N →
    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.dividendAllocation.{u_1} (Harsanyi.unanimity.{u_1} A c) N i)
      (ite.{1} (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A i) (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} c ↑(Finset.card.{u_1} A)) 0)

declarations.name: PaperProofs.centered_reconstruction
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.reconstruct.{u_1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} v)) S)
    (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (v S) (v EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u_1}))

declarations.name: PaperProofs.centered_dividend_agreement
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Finset.Nonempty.{u_1} S →
    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} v) S) (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v S)

declarations.name: LibraryConsumer.affine_nonempty
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (a b : Real) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Finset.Nonempty.{u_1} S →
    Eq.{1}
      (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (fun (T : Finset.{u_1} α) => HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} a (v T)) b) S)
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} a (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v S))

declarations.name: LibraryConsumer.baseline_unique_nonempty
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (v d : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α),
  (∀ (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
      Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.reconstruct.{u_1} d S) (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (v S) (v EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u_1}))) →
    ∀ (S : Finset.{u_1} α), Finset.Nonempty.{u_1} S → Eq.{1} (d S) (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v S)
